name: Theo
label: Feature-hunting power user
who: I am a heavy listener who checks whether Spotify's features work with Last.fm and third-party apps. I want playcounts, clear artist and album pages, and good radio and recommendation tools.
value_for_money: Price is rarely the focus. They note that some features need Premium, such as Spotify Connect and seeking on the free tier, and that Last.fm scrobbling works without a Last.fm Pro subscription. They say a third-party stats app's Pro tier is not expensive.
loyalty: They stay for Spotify's radio, recommendations and quick playlist creation, and one calls Spotify the most feature-rich option they have tried. What would push them away is missing features or lost controls, such as the removed album-radio option and cluttered artist labels.
pain_points: Artist names shown under every track
likes: Quick playlist creation, especially with friends
reasons_to_stay: They keep Spotify for radio stations, recommendation features and quick playlist creation, especially with friends, and one user says Spotify is the most feature-rich service they know. Their complaints target specific missing features, and they still see the feature set as Spotify's main strength.
tone: Practical and terse, asking specific how-to questions and offering quick tips, with mild frustration about missing features.
